mission.title: Meltdown
mission.description: Plant a virus in the Effectuator's network and break into his base.

npc.say: Take good care of our baby, huh? She's a beautiful piece of code.
Don't let the door hit you in the ass on your way out.

phase.briefing: We've tracked down the location of the Effectuator's inner circle. The noose is closing around his withered neck, and you're gonna be the hangman. Once he's out of the way, Zion will take over the constructs he controlled, cutting off a major section of the Merovingian's power base. Then we'll watch the diseased Frenchman twist in his own leather straps.

enter.say: I'm reading a hefty computer system and an unknown number of dire lupines in there. We need to get into that system so we can trace the Effectuator back to his mainframe.

complete.say: Good. I should have enough data to trace across their network now.

phase.briefing: While we're tracing the Effectuator's computer network, you're going to go get a little present for our doddering old friend--payback for something he gave us recently, if you will.

enter.say: That's the place. Go talk to Albireo.

talk.say: Ah, yeah, Anome told me you were coming. We've got a special virus prepared for you. Just put this in a computer on the target's network, and within about five seconds they will wish they'd never had a network to begin with. Satisfaction guaranteed or your money back! Go ahead, take it.
Come on, take it. It won't bite...you.

phase.briefing: Hahaha! We've got that crotchety bastard now! Once you get that virus in his systems, not only will it blaze a trail for us back to his mainframe, but it will also destroy his control mechanism for the Merovingian's private constructs. Oh, I can't wait to see the look on the Effectuator's face as his systems destroy themselves before his rheumy old eyes!

enter.say: I'm picking up more computers and dire lupines in there. You have to get the virus into one of his systems. Also, we need to take out all the lupines in the area, so they won't shut the systems down and make it harder to trace the virus from this location as it seeks out his mainframe.

objective.text: Kill all of the dire lupines

done.say: That takes care of all the dire lupines in the area, as far as I can see.

objective.text: Put the virus into the computer

done.say: And the virus is off and running. Oooh... That thing really does look nasty.

Hey, I've got an update for you: looks like Zion decided to send us some backup for the big assault on the Effectuator's base. Sirius and Fedynskij have already entered that area--meet them in a room nearby and lead them outside.

talk.say: All right! This is gonna be sweet.

objective.text: Lead Sirius and Fedynskij out of the area

phase.briefing: This is it! The virus has traced a path back to the Effectuator's base, and must be trashing his data as we speak. Break in there and finish the geezer off! Make it hurt...

enter.say: That's the place. I can see the virus permeating the local network; they should be in pretty bad shape.

talk.say: And so we meet again. I have to say, operative, that I didn't think you'd be this much...
Huh? He's instantiating himself multiple times again--but in the same room, now. He must be a blast at parties.
...of an annoyance. Kudos to you. However, surely you realize by now...
...that you can't actually harm my root program. Oh, dear me, no. You'd have...
...to hack a major part of several backbone servers in order to do that. You might as well...
...try rewriting Downtown into a theme park, while you're at it. So you see, you've really...
...just managed to waste a good deal of time for both of us. You won't get to the Merovingian...

...through me, that much I can tell you.
Now, I will bid you good day. We won't see each other again for quite some time. Don't bother collecting your hired ruffians, I've tidied them up for you.

done.say: Uh... I'm out of ideas. Anome was thinking that zapping his computers would make him vulnerable, I guess, but obviously that hasn't happened.

mission.finish:
What? What d'you mean, you couldn't touch him? We melted down his control systems! He had nothing left! Nothing! I-I-I... You've got a lot of explaining to do!
This must be Tyndall's fault. She said she didn't think it would work... What did she know? She's holding out on me! We'll just see what her precious Commander Lock thinks of this when I march into his office and explain it to him! Stay by your phone, operative--I'm not done with you yet, either.
